identity_boundary: Relational working language only; no continuity or authority claim.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only source-state probe used a direct foreach-to-pipeline form that PowerShell rejected before execution.
observed_failures.recovery: Materialize the bounded array before piping it to JSON.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize PowerShell iteration output before downstream pipelines.

observed_failures.observed: An overbroad exact-head resolver matched 7,003 repository files and exceeded useful output before the ordered Orin packet could be attributed.
observed_failures.recovery: Restrict discovery to the exact Orin v657-v6 subtree and named installed-skill paths.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never scan the whole historical tree for current-phase guidance.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only lookup guessed docs/orin-thale/v657-v6/validation/closeout-validation.json, which does not exist.
observed_failures.recovery: Enumerate the immutable exact-final tree and use its exact receipt names.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never infer lifecycle artifact names when the exact tree is available.

observed_failures.observed: An archive-wide rg --files probe exceeded the wrapper maxBuffer and returned no complete bounded inventory.
observed_failures.recovery: Query exact named archive directories and patterns without enumerating the entire archive.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Bound archive discovery before recursive enumeration.

observed_failures.observed: A content search for an external canonical-receipt digest timed out and reset its helper without finding a repository-backed receipt.
observed_failures.recovery: Do not repeat the search; preserve the digest from the acknowledged activation as activation evidence only.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Never content-scan a huge worktree after the bounded exact artifact path is established absent.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only test lookup guessed tests/test_ghc_family_v657_v6_x2.py, which is not part of the exact source tree.
observed_failures.recovery: Enumerate the exact test tree before loading a lifecycle suite.

observed_failures.observed: The worktree-add wrapper yielded without preserving its inner session while git reset --hard still held index.lock; a premature status probe displayed a huge transient deletion view.
observed_failures.recovery: Wait for the exact owned Git processes and index lock to clear, then verify the registered branch and materialized tree with scalar probes.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: After an unattributed worktree-add wrapper, audit process, lock, path, branch, and HEAD before status or retry.

observed_failures.observed: A combined clean-state wrapper did not preserve the inner sessions for long diff, status, and untracked probes, so blank outputs lacked exit-code attribution.
observed_failures.recovery: Run the exact clean-state probes individually and poll each through an attributable exit code.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Use one scalar Git state probe per supervised session on a large worktree.

observed_failures.observed: A multi-hunk phase-data patch mixed ASCII anchors with a differently decoded Māori line and was atomically rejected without changing the file.
observed_failures.recovery: Replace the bounded owner file through apply-patch delete-and-add with explicit UTF-8 text.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep Unicode-sensitive whole-file replacements atomic and independently review the resulting bytes.

observed_failures.observed: An owner-local untracked bootstrap placeholder was created and immediately removed before any staging because it was not required for the x1 edit surface.
observed_failures.recovery: Retain the no-credit workflow lapse and keep only declared x1 files.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not create sentinel files when apply-patch can directly target the intended owner file.

observed_failures.observed: A generated apply-patch removal for an inert migration template used PowerShell-decoded text that did not byte-match the UTF-8 source and was atomically rejected.
observed_failures.recovery: Leave the template explicitly marked inert and route all generated output through the reviewed v657-v7 overview function.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not build exact patches from a shell-decoded Unicode round trip; use stable ASCII anchors or direct UTF-8 patch text.

observed_failures.recovery: Redesign the affected mechanisms around configuration change, ingress quarantine, interlock causality, low-light pacing, dawn turnover, multisensory wayfinding, configuration integrity, interruption recovery, night vigilance, audience-limited observing plans, calibration supersession, and coherence nonconversion, then rerun the full screen.
